column3: The Hebrew makes the LORD the active subject of putting on majesty and strength and pictures girding Himself; BSB first uses is robed.
The Hebrew repeats rivers three times; BSB varies floodwaters, rivers, and seas.
The Hebrew has voices in the plural and repeats mighty; BSB says roar and majestic.
The Hebrew says holiness befits Your house and length of days; BSB says adorns and all the days to come.
